svg.title: Every public format, by family: 62 families, 1,959 formats
svg.desc: 62 families of public formats in 11 domains, 1,959 formats in all; each family is shown with its number of packs, counted from packs/. Air: ASTERIX 30, ADS-B 2, readsb JSON 2, GDL 90 1. Land vehicles: CAN DBC (opendbc) 91, Baidu Apollo 48, Tier IV (ROS 2) 13, Autoware (ROS 2) 11, Eclipse KUKSA.val 8, Tesla Fleet Telemetry 5, Waymo Open Dataset 2, OpenXC 1. Sea: NMEA 2000 2, AIS 1, NMEA 0183 1. Space: Space Data Standards 297, CCSDS frames and packets 5, CCSDS NDM/XML 1. Uncrewed systems and robots: ArduPilot DataFlash log 342, PX4 ULog 301, Cyphal (UAVCAN v1) 250, DroneCAN (UAVCAN v0) 133, ROS 2 interface packages 41, MAVLink 2 14, Open-RMF (ROS 2) 13, Foxglove 2, DRIP (RFC 9575) 1, Remote ID (ASTM F3411) 1. C2 and tactical: Cursor on Target 2, UCI 2, A-GRA 1, C2SIM 1, Canonical Track v2 1, GeoTrackV1 1, NVG 1. Sensors: NITF 2.1 32, ISA 4, SAPIENT 2, gpsd JSON 1, MISB ST 0601 1. Transport: GBFS 84, GTFS Schedule 31, WZDx 10, NeTEx 4, GTFS Realtime 2, MDS 1, Valhalla 1. IoT: FIWARE Smart Data Models 93, Meshtastic 12, Sparkplug B 1. Networks: OpenTelemetry OTLP 9, gNMI 8, IETF packet headers 7. Maps, weather and alerts: NWS weather.gov API 18, OpenStreetMap PBF 3, CAP alerts 1, Geobuf 1, GeoJSON 1, GPX 1, KML 1, Mapbox Vector Tile 1, STAC Item 1. Not shown: the 116 synthetic packs whose names start with conformance or demo-, which exercise the specification and stand for no real format.
svg.text: Every public format, by family: 62 families, 1,959 formats
